description:
Midstream is an AI-native financial operating system for health systems, founded by experienced entrepreneurs and backed by top-tier investors. We give finance, supply chain, and managed care teams real-time visibility into where margin is at risk, with a precise action plan for capturing it before it's gone.

Purpose-built for healthcare's complexity, Midstream transforms structured, unstructured, and external data into instant, contract-aware insights that drive smarter decisions. Our AI agents unify spend and revenue operations across the full back-office, learning and adapting with every interaction and delivering always-on intelligence that no point solution or one-off engagement can match.

We're compressing months to minutes and turning post-period hindsight into in-the-moment foresight. The tempo of healthcare finance is changing, and Midstream is leading it.

Opportunity

We're looking for a Lead Forward Deployed Engineer to build and lead the data engineering function that connects Midstream's platform to some of the country's largest health systems.

You'll work directly with customers to navigate complex enterprise systems, unlock access to fragmented healthcare data, and build the pipelines that power our AI-native platform. From collaborating with hospital IT and security teams to designing integrations across ERPs, EHRs, and financial systems, you'll own the critical first step in helping health systems uncover and recover financial value.

As our first dedicated forward-deployed data engineer, you'll have the opportunity to build this function from the ground up. You'll solve complex customer challenges hands-on, turn one-off solutions into scalable platform capabilities, and establish the technical standards and processes that allow us to deliver value faster with every new customer.

How you'll make an impact

Unlock access to complex healthcare data

Partner directly with customer IT, security, and data teams to navigate enterprise systems, establish secure access, and define practical approaches to data acquisition. Build trusted relationships with technical stakeholders and remove the barriers that stand between customer data and measurable financial impact.

Build robust data integrations

Design and develop pipelines that extract, transform, reconcile, and integrate structured and unstructured data from customer systems into Midstream's platform. Work across warehouses, lakehouses, enterprise applications, files, and external data sources, ensuring data is accurate, secure, and ready to power financial insights and AI-driven workflows. Support writing data back into customer systems when needed.

Use AI to accelerate data acquisition

Develop agentic workflows and automation that transform how we access and integrate customer data. From navigating complex portals to interpreting unfamiliar datasets and accelerating connector development, you'll apply AI to reduce manual effort and make integrations faster, more reliable, and increasingly repeatable.

Turn customer solutions into scalable platform capabilities

Move quickly to solve immediate customer challenges while identifying opportunities to build reusable infrastructure. Transform customer-specific integrations, connectors, and workflows into scalable capabilities that reduce engineering effort and accelerate onboarding with every deployment.

Own the customer data workstream

Lead the data integration process from initial discovery through deployment. Scope requirements, establish timelines, manage dependencies, and coordinate directly with customer stakeholders, from database administrators to executive sponsors. Proactively identify risks, communicate progress, and ensure data is delivered reliably and on time.

Build and lead a high-performing engineering function

As the founding member of our forward-deployed data engineering team, you'll establish technical standards, implementation practices, and expectations for excellence. Remain hands-on while helping hire, mentor, and develop engineers as the team grows, building a function that can scale without compromising quality or speed.

Who you are

  • An experienced, hands-on data engineer: You have deep experience building production-grade data pipelines, integrating complex enterprise systems, and solving challenging data modeling and entity resolution problems. You're comfortable working across the full data lifecycle, from acquisition and transformation to reliable delivery.

  • Experienced with complex enterprise data: You've worked directly with financial, healthcare, or similarly complex enterprise systems and understand the operational realities behind fragmented data, legacy infrastructure, and challenging integrations.

  • Comfortable working directly with customers: You have experience embedding with customer teams, navigating complex organizations, and building credibility with stakeholders ranging from technical operators to senior executives. You're energized by solving problems alongside customers, including spending extended periods on-site.

  • A strong communicator: You can translate complex technical challenges into clear, actionable plans for both technical and non-technical audiences. You write thoughtful documentation, communicate proactively, and know how to build alignment across stakeholders.

  • A hands-on technical leader: You've led small engineering teams or technical initiatives while remaining close to the work. You can set direction, make sound technical decisions, manage delivery, and help others succeed without losing your ability or willingness to build.

  • AI-native and automation-minded: You have practical experience applying AI agents to real-world engineering problems. You naturally look for opportunities to automate repetitive work, experiment with new approaches, and build systems that become more effective over time.

  • A high-ownership builder: You thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and enjoy creating structure where none exists. You're motivated by customer outcomes, move quickly to solve problems, and think beyond the immediate solution to what will scale.

Experience with healthcare data, enterprise integrations, or forward-deployed engineering organizations is a plus.

The Stack

What you'll build with

Python, SQL, and modern data engineering frameworks such as pandas, dlt, and dbt, alongside AI-powered development and automation tools.

What you'll build against

A broad range of customer systems, including EHRs, ERPs, contract management platforms, and enterprise data infrastructure. Examples include Epic, Oracle, Workday, Infor Lawson, SAP, symplr, Levelpath, Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, GHX, and GPO or wholesaler portals.

You don't need experience with every system. What matters is your ability to quickly understand unfamiliar technologies, navigate their complexity, and build reliable integrations.

Location & Travel

Location: Remote, with convenient access to a major airport.

Travel: Regular travel to customer sites during active implementations. Expect approximately 2–3 days per week on-site during the first 3–5 weeks of an engagement, with travel varying as implementations progress and overlap.
